text:
eva: Morning folks — random thought: sunrise bagels & brain-teasers next Tuesday at 8:30am in the lobby? Bagels, quick coffee, and a 15-min puzzle round (crossword/verbal). Low-effort, good for folks who like early social stuff. Who's interested? :bagel: :coffee:

noah: I'm 100% here for bagels. can someone grab everything? happy to chip in $5. :money_with_wings:

mei: love the idea. I can bring a mini crossword pack and a set of pens. vegan bagel options ok?

raj: count me in. FYI i commute early, so perfect. also can bring a small Bluetooth speaker for chill morning tunes.

eva: thanks! i'll ask People Ops about a $7/head snack allowance for breakfast purchases. If not approved we'll do collect $5 from attendees.

ops-bot: Quick note: breakfast/socials under $10/head are eligible for "team-social" expense category. Submit receipts and list attendees. Approval 24-48h. Link: https://redwood.internal/expenses

noah: going to run a 1-question poll: :bagel: = yes (in-person), :house: = remote but will drop in chat, :x: = nope.

mei: :bagel:

raj: :bagel:

noah: looks like a small crowd. eva can you put a calendar invite? i'll volunteer to pickup bagels at 8:05am if someone shares vendor preference.

eva: i'll do invite + note dietary prefs. vendor suggestion: "Corner Morning" does good sesame/vegan options. Raj, huge help if you can pick up. i'll DM you cash.

mei: also can we add a tiny prize? winner of the puzzle gets a free coffee voucher. no pressure.

raj: yes to prize. i'll grab paper cups and napkins.

eva: perfect. remote folks — we'll post pics and the crossword in the channel so you can play along. See y'all Tuesday 8:30! :sunrise:
